title: Introducing OpenAI for Government
summary: We’re launching OpenAI for Government, a new initiative focused on bringing our most advanced AI tools to public servants across the United States. We’re supporting the U.S. government's efforts in adopting best-in-class technology and deploying these tools in service of the public good.
body: We’re launching OpenAI for Government, a new initiative focused on bringing our most advanced AI tools to public servants across the United States. We’re supporting the U.S. government's efforts in adopting best-in-class technology and deploying these tools in service of the public good.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布“OpenAI for Government”计划，旨在将先进的AI工具引入美国政府部门。该举措旨在支持公共部门利用顶尖技术提升行政效率与公共服务质量，是大型语言模型在政府领域规模化应用的重要里程碑，体现了AI技术在公共治理中的战略价值。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式推出针对政府部门的AI服务，标志着大模型在公共部门应用落地的重要进展。

glossary.explanationZh: 指专门为政府和公共机构设计的AI部署方案，强调合规性与安全性。
指具备高可靠性、安全性和可扩展性的企业级AI服务标准。
将AI模型集成到实际业务流程中的实施过程。
指AI技术在提升社会福利和公共服务方面的应用目标。
